title: Efficient Data Fusion in Distributionally Robust Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.34495v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decisions under uncertainty increasingly rest on fragmented evidence, such as samples from related but different populations, privacy-protected summary statistics, or complementary statistical descriptions of the same data. Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) can fuse such evidence by constructing one ambiguity set per source and hedging against all distributions in the intersection of these sets. This fusion approach is less conservative than aggregating the sources into a single ambiguity set, but it is computationally demanding. Exact reformulations grow exponentially with the number of sources, and even deciding whether the intersection is nonempty is NP-hard. We show that fusion DRO admits an exact reformulation in which the ambiguity sets are coupled only through functional Lagrange multipliers. translated_title: 分布鲁棒优化中的高效数据融合
translated_abstract: 不确定性下的决策日益依赖于碎片化的证据，例如来自相关但不同总体的样本、隐私保护的汇总统计数据，或对同一数据的互补统计描述。分布鲁棒优化（DRO）可以通过为每个数据源构建一个模糊集，并对这些模糊集交集内的所有分布进行对冲来融合此类证据。这种融合方法比将所有数据源聚合为单一模糊集更少保守性，但计算代价高昂：精确重构会随数据源数量呈指数级增长，甚至判断交集是否非空本身就是NP难问题。本文证明融合DRO存在一种精确重构形式，其中各模糊集仅通过函数型拉格朗日乘子耦合。将这些乘子限制为仿射决策规则即可得到可在各模糊集间分解的上界，并在一定条件下具有精确性（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出仅通过函数型拉格朗日乘子耦合各模糊集的融合分布鲁棒优化精确重构方法，并利用仿射决策规则近似得到可分解的高效上界，从而克服了传统方法随数据源数量呈指数级增长的计算瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that fusion DRO admits an exact reformulation in which ambiguity sets are coupled only through functional Lagrange multipliers, and that restricting these multipliers to affine decision rules yields tractable, decomposable upper bounds, avoiding the exponential complexity of existing approaches.
